rules.description: Applicant must be receiving or applying for Universal Credit
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be receiving or applying for Universal Credit to get the carer's element

rules.description: Applicant must provide care for at least 35 hours per week
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide care for at least 35 hours per week to qualify for the carer's element

rules.description: Person cared for must receive a qualifying disability benefit
rules.reason_if_failed: The person you care for must receive one of the qualifying disability benefits at the required rate

rules.description: Applicant cannot receive both carer's element and LCWRA element
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot receive the carer's element if you already receive the limited capability for work and work-related activity (LCWRA) element

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old (UC eligibility)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to claim Universal Credit and the carer's element

rules.description: Only one carer's element per household if both partners care for the same person
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner already receives the carer's element for this person. Only one carer's element can be paid per household for the same care recipient

explanation_template: Carer's element eligibility: {outcome}. Additional amount: £201.68 per month if approved.

edge_cases.description: Care recipient currently receives severe disability premium
edge_cases.action: Hand off to work coach. Warning: The person you care for may lose their severe disability premium when you claim the carer's element. They should be informed before proceeding.

edge_cases.description: Potential safeguarding concern regarding care arrangements
edge_cases.action: Immediate handoff to specialist team. Care arrangement requires verification and assessment of suitability.

edge_cases.description: Multiple people claim to care for the same person more than 35 hours each
edge_cases.action: Hand off to case manager. Assessment required to determine who provides the majority of care and how hours are split.

edge_cases.description: Care recipient's qualifying benefit is under review or ending soon
edge_cases.action: Inform applicant that carer's element will stop if care recipient loses qualifying benefit. May need to reapply if benefit is reinstated.

edge_cases.description: Caring appears to be part of paid employment rather than unpaid care
edge_cases.action: Hand off to fraud investigation team. Carer's element is for unpaid care only, not paid employment as a carer.
